slots.name: US leadership concern
slots.sentence: In an annual poll of Southeast Asian elites conducted between January and mid-February this year, the top geopolitical concern respondents listed was U.S. leadership (51.9%)

slots.name: South China Sea concern
slots.sentence: with aggressive behavior in the South China Sea coming in third (48.2%).

slots.name: China alignment share
slots.sentence: When asked whether they would align with the United States or China if forced to choose, 52% of respondents selected China over the United States (48%).

slots.name: Country China lead
slots.sentence: China’s lead was considerably larger at the country level, particularly in Indonesia (+60.2 percentage points), Malaysia (+36 points), and even U.S. partner Singapore (+32.6 points).

slots.name: China economic influence
slots.sentence: this year, roughly 56% chose China as the most influential economic power while the United States trailed at about 15%.
